subject: Renewal: isolated environment + additional clusters (MAP & timelines)
messages:
From: Lina Gomez <lina@medicorps.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + isolated environment & extra clusters request

Hi Irene,

Hope you
re well. Our renewal window is approaching (contract ends 2027-06-15) and our security team has requested a separate, isolated VPC environment for all PII workloads. High level asks: 

- New VPC in us-west-2 controlled by Redwood Private (VPC peering + separate audit logs)
- Two additional cluster pools (3 GPU nodes each) for isolation and burst capacity
- 7-year audit log retention and KMS integration using our AWS KMS key

I attached the SOC2 evidence snapshot we have for internal review (SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf). Can you outline what the mutual action plan (MAP) and timeline would look like to hit a cutoff around 2027-06-10 to allow a short testing window before renewal? Also need estimated incremental monthly cost for the committed capacity and a draft amendment we can circulate to procurement.

Thanks,
Lina Gomez\Director of Infrastructure\MediCorps Health
attachments: SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Lina Gomez <lina@medicorps.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + isolated environment & extra clusters request

Hi Lina 
nd team,

Thanks for the clear ask and the SOC2 snapshot. We can absolutely support an isolated VPC plus the two additional cluster pools; we like to formalize a short MAP so everyonean track owners and dates. High-level next steps I propose: 

1) Info pass (this week): expected steady-state QPS and peak concurrency, network CIDR for peering, AWS account/KMS ARN, compliance contact (we have Rajiv on cc), and required SLAs for cutover.
2) Technical kickoff (within 5 business days): Redwood Solutions (Dev) + MedCorps infra to validate peering, KMS rotation, and KV cache behavior under isolation.
3) Provisioning & staging (2-3 weeks): create VPC, deploy clusters, run smoke tests, enable extended audit retention.
4) Cutover dry-run (1 week before target), then production switch.

I attached a MAP draft (MAP-draft.xlsx) with owners and a preliminary timeline. Early items we need from you: steady-state RPS estimate and the specific KMS key ARN.

For budget: Marissa will follow up with a term amendment and committed-node pricing options (12-month vs 24-month). If you want a target number today, ballpark incremental delta for the two 3-node pools on dedicated hardware would be ~ $24k/month before potential term discounts. We confirm in the term sheet.

Available for a 30-minute call today at 2pm PT or tomorrow morning. Which works?

Best,
Irene Choi\Strategic Account Lead, Redwood Inference\phone: (415) 555-0123
attachments: MAP-draft.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lina Gomez <lina@medicorps.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + isolated environment & extra clusters request

Hi Lina / Irene,

Irene: thanks for the MAP outline. Lina: quick note on commercials and options so procurement has something to review: 

- Option A (12-month): committed pools (2 x 3-node GPU pools) + isolated VPC provisioned. Estimated incremental: $24,000/month.
- Option B (24-month): same configuration, 12% term discount applied to committed monthly rate.
- Amendment: we issue a 1-page amendment for the environment + committed capacity lines and a new SLA clause for audit retention/forensics.

I attached the latest term sheet (term_sheet_v3.pdf) with placeholders for PO and billing contacts. If you can confirm the procurement timeline we scope the billing start date accordingly.

I can join the technical kickoff if needed and will own the commercial amendment. Proposed milestone: sign amendment by 2027-05-20 to keep provisioning on track for a mid-June cutover. Does that align with your procurement cadence?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole\Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Lina Gomez <lina@medicorps.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@medicorps.com>, ops@medicorps.com
Date: 2027-05-03T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + isolated environment & extra clusters request

Irene / Marissa,

Thanks or the quick replies. Answers below: 

- Steady-state: ~120 requests/sec (average), peaks up to 420 rps during batch windows.
- Concurrency / tokens: typical sessions ~4 concurrent token streams, 2k token average prompt.
- KMS: we will provide an AWS KMS ARN in us-west-2 (will share by EOD tomorrow).
- Procurement: procurement can issue PO within 7 business days after amendment is agreed. Need amendment signed + PO by 2027-05-24 to meet your proposed provisioning schedule.
- Cutover target: we prefer 2027-06-10 for opt-in testing and production switch on 2027-06-15.

Rajiv (copied) will be our compliance lead and will coordinate any evidence you need beyond the SOC2 snapshot. Hean also do a 30-minute sync with Dev next week.

We also like confirmation on audit log retention mechanics (do you store logs in our S3 or Redwood-managed storage?) and proof of encryption-at-rest for the KV cache and model snapshots. Those are compliance gate items for our team.

Lina
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Lina Gomez <lina@medicorps.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@medicorps.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T14:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + isolated environment & extra clusters request

Lina / Rajiv / team,

Appreciate the quick clarifications — that alignment gets us a lot of traction. Action list (finalizing MAP and owners):

- Lina: provide KMS ARN and network CIDR (due 2027-05-05) 
- Rajiv: compliance checklist & any additional evidence requests (due 2027-05-06)
- Dev (Redwood): schedule technical kickoff + validate peering approach (schedule by 2027-05-07)
- Marissa (Redwood): circulate amendment draft for signature (first draft by 2027-05-06)
- Irene (Redwood): track MAP and sync weekly until cutover

Responding to the log question: we offer two audit retention models — (A) Redwood-managed archival (encrypted, separate S3 bucket per customer) or (B) export to customer-managed S3 with server-side encryption using your KMS key. For MediCorps we can enable option B if you want full custody of logs; Dev will validate access and lifecycle.

Regarding encryption of runtime state (KV cache/model snapshots): all at-rest artifacts in the isolated environment are encrypted using AWS KMS keys. With your KMS ARN we can configure a CMK policy bound to the VPC project. We will include that language in the amendment.

Next step: I like to lock a 30-minute technical kickoff for 2027-05-07 at 10am PT. If that works, I ask Rajiv and a dev contact from your side to attend.

I will attach the updated MAP and track items in HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/7281

Best,
Irene Choi\Strategic Account Lead, Redwood Inference
attachments: MAP-draft.xlsx, term_sheet_v3.pdf
